svg.title: Tiling of the upper half plane by images of the fundamental domain of PSL2(Z): the shaded region I above the unit circle between Re z = -1/2 and 1/2, neighbouring vertical strips T, T^2, T^-1, T^-2, the regions S, TS, T^2S, T^-1S, T^-2S under the unit circles centred at the integers, and smaller regions such as ST, STS, ST^-1, TST bounded by circles of radius 1/3; the real axis is marked from -2 to 2.
